purpose: Compare four comprehensible Tapline opening plans while holding rules, map, mind, classes, seeds, and side assignments fixed.

entrants.label: Direct Mid
entrants.intent: Take the shortest route as one pack, control centre, then press the enemy Well while converting loose Cores.

entrants.label: Shadow Pincer
entrants.intent: Send two four-body wings around the long corridors, breach together, and screen the enemy home-to-Well exits for two runners.

entrants.label: Split Interception
entrants.intent: Watch both outer corridors with paired interceptors, screen centre, and retain a home logistics pair for loose-Core recovery.

entrants.label: Distributed Wells
entrants.intent: Field a 3-3-2 economy across enemy, centre, and home Wells so all three Core streams have workers and local support.

evaluation.design: twelve fresh seed blocks, every unordered pair, both side assignments
evaluation.outcomesAre: a deterministic design screen over these registered seeds, not a human-fun or population claim
evaluation.leverPolicy: Only a cross-matchup dominance alarm authorizes one minimal one-factor rules or geometry probe; otherwise preserve the game and improve candidate intent instead.

requiresReviewOrMigration: adding or removing a Well or other objective
